name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Searchable select: typing filters the list. Single select (ComboboxInput) or multi-select with removable chips (ComboboxChipsInput), an announced empty state, and rich rows via ComboboxItem children. Async options (`loadOptions(query, { signal })`: debounced, stale requests aborted, announced loading and error states with a Retry row) and creatable (`onCreate(input)` adds a “Create …” row). Opt-in `virtualized` windows flat items arrays (including async, Create and Retry rows); grouped items and static children retain full rendering. ComboboxContent accepts itemHeight (fixed pixels), estimatedItemHeight (default 32) and overscan (default 4). Keyboard highlights stay mounted; filtering resets scroll and reopening reveals the selection. Find-in-page and screen-reader browse mode reach mounted rows only; keyboard navigation reaches all options. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries. Grouped `{ value, items }` collections use ComboboxGroup, ComboboxGroupLabel, ComboboxSeparator and ComboboxCollection. Pass each filtered group's items to ComboboxGroup; ComboboxCollection renders its options (renderless unless className supplies a container). Labels and separators share Select styles. useComboboxFilter exposes Base UI's locale-aware matching for custom filters. Filtering hides empty groups and labels; keyboard navigation crosses groups. Async results may be grouped, and Create/Retry rows stay outside groups. See ComboboxGrouped for grouped creatable and async previews.
